children: Lockheed Martin Missiles and Fire Control
was awarded a $244.96M firm-fixed-price modification to a previously awarded contract by the U.S. Navy.

This modification adds scope to procure Full Rate Production 2 of F/A-18E/F Infrared Search and Track Block II systems, to include 48 infrared receivers (45 for the Navy and three for the Royal Australian Air Force), 74 processors, and 27 inertial measurement units for the Navy, as well as test equipment maintenance and lay-in material.
The work will be performed across locations including Florida, California, Florida, and Pennsylvania; and is expected to be completed in February 2031.

The Navy has also awarded Lockheed a $52.11M cost-plus-fixed-fee modification to a previously awarded contract to incorporate engineering changes into the F-35 Lot 18-19 air vehicle production, including improvements and production incorporation of new capabilities for various aircraft variants for the Air Force, Marine Corps, Navy, F-35 Cooperative Partners, and Foreign Military Sales

Separately, Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems, Moorestown, New Jersey, was awarded a $724M contract modification for the Japanese Ministry of Defense. The total value of the contract is increased from $1.64B to $2.36B.
The contract includes delivery of Aegis System-equipped vessel (ASEV) #1 and ASEV #2 AEGIS Combat System to Japan.
The work will be performed in Moorestown, New Jersey, and Japan from Sept. 29, 2026, through March 31, 2030.
